Description

Were looking for a AI Engineer to join our team and help design, build and ship the agentic, retrieval and voice systems at the core of what we deliver for clients.

Responsibilities

Youll work end-to-end across our six-stage delivery process - from AI mapping and architecture through development, deployment and continuous evolution. Day to day, youll:

Build AI agents and workflow automation systems that carry real business processes from start to finish.
Design document intelligence solutions that combine OCR with LLMs to extract, understand and act on unstructured documents.
Develop multi-step AI workflows and decision engines that chain models, tools and business logic reliably.
Build RAG and retrieval pipelines over vector stores like Qdrant, pgvector, MongoDB Atlas and Redis, tuned for accuracy, latency and cost.Develop real-time voice agents using tools such as LiveKit, ElevenLabs, Deepgram and Whisper.
Integrate foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and open models (Llama, Mistral) into client systems and deploy them on cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) with Kubernetes and Terraform.
Ship all of the above with the evaluation, guardrails and observability needed to run reliably at scale - then keep improving it.
Qualifications
3+ years of software engineering experience, with hands-on work taking AI/ML or LLM-powered features to production.
Strong Python skills and fluency across the modern GenAI stack.
Depth in at least one of our focus areas - agentic systems, RAG/retrieval, or voice - and the drive to grow across the rest.
Strong evaluation skills: you build eval harnesses, measure model and system quality against real metrics, and iterate rather than eyeballing outputs.
A guardrails-first instinct - you design for safety, failure modes, hallucination, cost and reliability before a system ever reaches users.
Comfort integrating models via APIs and deploying containerized workloads on the cloud.
Clear communication and the ability to work directly with clients as an embedded team member.
Job Benefits
Fully remote across India - work from wherever youre most productive, with no commute and no relocation. Weve been remote-first for years, so the tools and habits that make distributed work smooth are already in place.
Flexible timings - we care about outcomes, not hours logged. Structure your day around when you do your best work and the commitments in your life outside it, and coordinate with your team on the overlap that matters.
Long weekend leaves - regular long weekends built into the calendar give you real time to step away, recharge and come back sharp, on top of your standard leave.
Opportunity to work with senior engineers, applied-AI researchers and data scientists on real production systems, and to grow quickly through direct mentorship and genuinely hard problems.
